dedupe_keys.name: egypt s projects map national map of government projects by sector and governorate

description: Egypt's Projects Map is a public web map of national development projects in Egypt, with project pages that can be filtered by category and by governorate. On the day it was read it listed 7,545 projects. By category these included roads, bridges and tunnels (1,002), drinking water and sanitation (1,024), electricity and renewable energy (239), water resources and irrigation (238), oil and natural gas (87), transport (134), housing and new cities (238), health (626), education (1,369), public services (420) and industry (189), among others; by governorate, Cairo had 740 projects, Beheira 756, Sharqia 638 and Giza 257. The governorates page gives each governorate's area, districts and population, and the site also lists ministries, presidential initiatives, a news centre and a form for citizens to propose ideas. Access is free online; no licence or download is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the site is in Arabic, it presents projects as map entries and pages, not a downloadable table, and the page does not say how often the list is updated or whether completed and planned projects are separated. Coverage is Egypt. It supports multi-sector infrastructure asset mapping and capacity planning, such as locating new roads, water and sanitation plants and power projects; related records are the Chile PNIP project portfolio and the Te Waihanga pipeline of New Zealand.
